claims.claim_ar: التَّحَوُّلُ فِي السَّلَكِ الخِطابيِّ من الأَمْرِ بِالْعَمَلِ إلى خَبَرٍ عَنِ اللَّهِ وَمَصِيرِ النَّاسِ (التفات)
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical shift (iltifat): the discourse moves from commanding action (establishing prayer, fearing God) to a statement about God and the eschatological gathering — a shift that arrests attention and converts practice into eschatological reminder.
